title: Ruskin Rose Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Ruskin Rose is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to Ruskin Rose — A Luxury Coastal Retreat in the Heart of SeasideTucked beneath the shaded canopy of Ruskin Park in the heart of Seaside, Ruskin Rose is a newly renovated luxury 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath townhome offering timeless coastal elegance, designer interiors, and an unbeatable walkable location just steps from Seaside’s iconic town center and only a short stroll to the beach. With its soft blush exterior, refined finishes, and inviting gathering spaces, this beautifully curated retreat captures the effortless sophistication of Seaside living.Inspired by the charm of New Orleans’ Jackson Square, Ruskin Park is known for its lush landscaping, boutique storefronts, art galleries, and peaceful green spaces — creating a tucked-away atmosphere while remaining moments from Seaside’s celebrated dining, shopping, and sugar-white beaches.First Floor LivingUpon entering the home, guests are welcomed into a bright and thoughtfully designed main living space centered around comfort and connection. The fully renovated chef’s kitchen features a stunning quartz island, top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, custom built-in cabinetry, and French doors that open directly onto charming Ruskin Place. Just off the kitchen, a cozy bistro dining nook overlooks the park — the perfect setting for morning coffee or evening cocktails beneath the trees.The adjacent dining area features a grand white dining table with seating for eight, ideal for family dinners and relaxed coastal evenings. Flowing seamlessly from the dining space, the inviting living room offers two plush sofas, accent seating, abundant natural light, peaceful views, a mounted flat-screen TV, and a fireplace for guest enjoyment. A conveniently located powder bath is tucked beneath the staircase on the main level.Second Floor RetreatsThe second floor features two beautifully appointed guest suites designed with comfort and privacy in mind. The spacious king primary suite offers a private balcony, mounted flat-screen TV, large dresser, and a luxurious renovated ensuite bathroom complete with dual vanities, quartz countertops, and a deep soaking tub with shower combination.Across the hall, the queen guest suite features a mounted flat-screen TV, closet, large dresser, and double French doors opening onto a peaceful balcony overlooking the treetops of Ruskin Park. The renovated ensuite bathroom includes a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.A full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located in the hallway laundry closet between the two suites.Third Floor AccommodationsThe third floor continues the home’s thoughtfully designed layout, offering additional accommodations ideal for families and groups. The bunk suite features two queen beds on the lower level with two twin XL bunks above, creating a stylish and functional retreat for children, teens, or additional guests. The room also includes a mounted flat-screen TV and a spacious ensuite bathroom with dual vanities and a soaking tub with shower combination.Across the hall, the fourth bedroom suite offers a queen bed, mounted flat-screen TV, dresser, closet, and French doors leading to another peaceful balcony overlooking Ruskin Park. The renovated ensuite bathroom features a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Outdoor Living & Seaside ConvenienceAfter sun-filled beach days and evenings exploring Seaside, guests can enjoy the convenience of a private outdoor shower located within the home’s secluded driveway area — perfect for rinsing off after the beach.Whether you’re planning a family beach vacation, couples’ getaway, or relaxing coastal retreat, Ruskin Rose offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, walkable convenience, and iconic Seaside charm.Please note: The fireplace, elevator, and tower are not available for guest use.* 5 night minimum Spring Break & Summer; 3 night minimum Spring & Fall; 3 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURESFeatures 2,583 square feet352 yards (4-minute walk) to private residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion; largest private beach on 30ACovered private parking for two vehicles in a carport with private drivewayThis home streams live TV through YouTubeTV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsFull size washer, dryerOutdoor showerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay and starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
